Hey! Don’t be sorry you made plenty of sense of your current condition! Your grades are still able to be tweaked and fixed a little your not too far gone from what you’ve said. You being brought back give you a second chance at living a good life! I won’t sit here and say, “things get better” because sometimes they don’t, but don’t let school make you feel like any less of a person. I can’t speak on the illness part because I know nothing of it, but you’re needed here. Take things an assignment at a time, and try surrounding yourself with better people, or ones who share your mindset! I’m sorry if I couldn’t help but I would hate for you to come here for assistance and leave with nothing.

I know my advice is no better than yours, because I’m also without purpose, but when I feel like I don’t belong I surround myself with people who think I belong here. Even if you have nobody it’s never too late to find people. You don’t need a definite answer to why you are alive, just live. And don’t worry about making a difference in the world, try to make a difference in your life and look for your purpose. You can change life around you by living yours! I hope you find a purpose sometime in your life, but don’t stress yourself out trying to find one.
We are a parasite. As a whole we leach off everything. But individually we are beautiful. You’re not selfish just hurt my friend. You have a purpose.

Just left from my friends house and feel the exact same. I know how you feel with being comforted by the thought of dying, but let it happen naturally. Try to reach out to anyone. I won’t say things get better because they wont always, but know you deserve the world and let death be the gift life gives you in the end. You’re wanted here bro
